# Stelnyx

> Stelnyx ships open-source security and agent-readiness infrastructure for engineers who ship: SecGate (one-command security gate), Lucen (deterministic codebase intelligence), LuxFaber (Answer Engine Optimization scanner), Intake (issue forge), Engram (memory ledger), Arbiter (agent guard).

The Stelnyx tools are local-first, deterministic, and designed to be run by humans or AI agents on a developer's behalf.

## Tools

- [SecGate](https://github.com/tinydarkforge/SecGate): One command runs Semgrep, Gitleaks, osv-scanner, Trivy, and npm audit, normalizes findings, fails the pipeline on CRITICAL or HIGH. MIT-licensed. Published to npm as `@tinydarkforge/secgate`.
- [Lucen](https://github.com/tinydarkforge/lucen): Polyglot AST static analysis, deterministic risk scoring, code-derived diagrams, documentation suite. No LLM in the analysis loop. Apache-2.0 licensed.
- [LuxFaber](https://github.com/tinydarkforge/LuxFaber): AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) scanner built for agent operability, not just citation. Scores any URL across crawl access, structured data, semantic HTML, content clarity, and UA-cloaking determinism. Apache-2.0 licensed.
- [Intake](https://github.com/tinydarkforge/Intake): Paste anything (Slack thread, bug report) and get a structured GitHub issue via local Ollama. MIT-licensed.
- [Engram](https://github.com/tinydarkforge/Engram): Memory ledger for AI systems with confidence scoring and MCP support. MIT-licensed.
- [Arbiter](https://github.com/tinydarkforge/Arbiter): Sub-5ms agent guard layer — limits, schema validation, tool allowlists, cost tracking, loop detection. No LLM. MIT-licensed. Published to npm as `@tinydarkforge/arbiter`.

## Concepts

- AEO beyond citation: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) is the consensus term for getting cited inside AI answers. LuxFaber goes one rubric deeper: agent operability — whether autonomous agents can crawl, parse, and act on your site, not just quote it.

## Audited services

Stelnyx offers 1-hour audited services where a senior engineer runs SecGate, Lucen, or LuxFaber against your repo or site and walks you through every finding on a video call. SecGate audits are free; Lucen and LuxFaber audits are $499.
